definitions.explanation: A state of being calm and unflustered regardless of circumstances, especially maintaining composure in the face of difficulty or danger. Suggests steadfastness and inner strength.

examples.japanese: {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく}
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危機|きき}→危機：11798_kiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{直面|ちょくめん}して→直面する：15862_chokumensuru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{泰然|たいぜん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: He remained calm even when facing a crisis.

examples.japanese: ⟦{批判|ひはん}→批判：03580_hihan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{浴|あ}びて→浴びる：02844_abiru⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{泰然|たいぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{崩|くず}さなかった→崩す：03919_kuzusu⟧。
examples.english: Even under heavy criticism, the president maintained his calm demeanor.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Often used adverbially as {泰然|たいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧.

FOUR-CHARACTER COMPOUND: {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく} (perfectly calm and collected) is a common set phrase emphasizing imperturbability.

NUANCE: {泰然|たいぜん} emphasizes unshakable composure in the face of adversity. It suggests inner fortitude and the ability to remain steady regardless of external pressures.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {泰然|たいぜん}{自若|じじゃく} (perfectly calm)
- {泰然|たいぜん}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ (to be unperturbed)
- {泰然|たいぜん}とした⟦{態度|たいど}→態度：03396_taido⟧ (composed attitude)
- {泰然|たいぜん}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{構|かま}える→構える：09567_kamaeru⟧ (to remain unruffled)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{悠然|ゆうぜん}→悠然：09172_yuuzen⟧ (calm, leisurely - emphasizes ease)
- ⟦{沈着|ちんちゃく}→沈着：09171_chinchaku⟧ (composed, cool-headed)
